GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.5 (6 Aug 46) GB
(SCAPIN-1105)
APO 500
6 August 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Apprehension of Japanese Nationals.
1. Memorandum to the Imperial Japanese Government, dated 26 May 1946, file AG 383.6 (26 May 46) GB (SCAPIN -985) wherein the Imperial Japanese Government is directed to daliver the following individuals to the authorities at Sugamo Prison for temporary detention is hereby rescinded:
Colonel ITO Kiyokazu
Major KIGOSHI, Yazukazu
Major SATO, Tatsuya
SATO, Kichinosuke
INOUYE, Yoichi
Major General ONOUCHI, Hirosi
SUGIHARA, Kyune
2. Persons who have been delivered to Commanding General, EIGHTH Army in compliance with the above quoted memorandum, are being released from Sugamo Prison.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
